name: Alex Bradford
current_role: CEO and Founder, Rain (earned wage access platform, rainapp.com)
profile: Founded Rain in 2019 to offer earned wage access and financial-wellness tools integrated with employers' payroll (Workday, etc.). Rain raised a $75M Series B led by Prosus (2025) and $300M in financing from Clear Haven. Stanford undergrad and HBS MBA, with brief stints at Goldman Sachs and McKinsey.
interesting_fact: Rain is his third fintech company; he got the idea in late 2018 after learning of a European employer-integrated finance company.
deep_cut_fact: At Stanford he was a teaching assistant for a Social Entrepreneurship course focused heavily on microcredit.
notes: Check Hurun's $2B valuation: it may conflate with Rain (rain.xyz), a separate stablecoin-card company. No press email found on rainapp.com.

name: Sachin Anand Dharap
current_role: EVP and Chief Financial Officer, Aragen Life Sciences
profile: CFO of Aragen Life Sciences (formerly GVK Biosciences), the Hyderabad-based CRDMO serving global pharma and biotech that is preparing for an IPO. Listed as senior management rather than a founder in Aragen's materials.
deep_cut_fact: He is a commerce graduate of the University of Mumbai.
notes: Hurun 'founder' label likely reflects shareholding; he is an executive.

name: Shajikumar Devakar
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Neo Wealth Management (Neo Group)
profile: Wealth-management veteran who joined Neo Group as co-founder and CEO of its wealth business in May 2025, after about nine years at 360 ONE Wealth (ex-IIFL Wealth) as Executive Director leading South India and Middle East (UAE) operations; earlier at Deutsche Bank Wealth Management.
interesting_fact: Neo Group reached unicorn status in 2026 and reports about Rs 1.3 lakh crore of client assets across 30+ cities.
deep_cut_fact: At 360 ONE (IIFL Wealth) he led both the South India business and its international operations in the UAE.
notes: Joined in 2025, so 'founder' is a title rather than 2021 founding role.

name: Rahul Raina
profile: Co-founded TRM Labs, the blockchain intelligence firm used by law enforcement and financial institutions to fight crypto-enabled crime, and leads its technology. Previously a software engineer at Amazon and Opendoor and a McKinsey consultant.
deep_cut_fact: He earned a dual degree at the University of Michigan: a BS in Computer Science plus a BBA from the Ross School of Business.
